bounded_recoveries.procedure: separate native Git scalar probes from PowerShell summary construction
use one exact git ls-tree size projection and read required files in contiguous bounded windows
materialize rows before piping and preserve the parser failure at zero credit
replay all exact objects through one length-framed git cat-file batch
target the literal directory with an explicit glob option instead of a shell wildcard
inspect the exact branch and worktree state and wait for the attributable worktree process without retrying mutation
stop only the attributable orphaned list process and use literal branch and path probes
inspect exact process ownership and wait for that checkout to finish before any write
stop only the attributable read-only status probe and avoid Git status until checkout quiescence
bind the conditional scalar before constructing the diagnostic object
use bounded waits and verify the exact checkout process and index state separately
retain the source-access failure and use the current official CycloneDX and OASIS CSAF primary specifications for vocabulary
remove wrapper-sensitive code ticks from the bounded prose replacement and repeat the exact block rewrite
verify process quiescence and the exact artifact set, then invoke the deterministic builder in a resumable terminal session
write the validator receipt to an external D-drive path and project only exit status, validity, error count, and digest
resolve the exact installed ghc-family-auth-permission-state validator path before invocation
require a successful validator exit and parse the explicitly written receipt rather than mixed process output
stop using the sparse repository path and inspect the installed skill inventory directly
run help against the exact installed skill validator and confirm its state and out arguments
read the exact installed validator source and then run it with an external receipt path

failures.failed_witness: the first combined PowerShell source probe failed parser validation before any Git query or state change
failures.recovery: separate native Git scalar probes from PowerShell summary construction

failures.failed_witness: the first per-file immutable packet size enumerator crossed its bounded wrapper without output
failures.recovery: use one exact git ls-tree size projection and read required files in contiguous bounded windows

failures.failed_witness: a PowerShell foreach block was piped directly during skill inventory and failed with EmptyPipeElement
failures.recovery: materialize rows before piping and preserve the parser failure at zero credit

failures.failed_witness: the first immutable manifest replay launched one Git process per entry and crossed its bounded envelope
failures.recovery: replay all exact objects through one length-framed git cat-file batch

failures.failed_witness: a Windows rg call passed an unexpanded final-directory wildcard and returned an invalid-filename error
failures.recovery: target the literal directory with an explicit glob option instead of a shell wildcard

failures.failed_witness: the initial no-checkout worktree creation crossed its wrapper after creating only the exact branch reference
failures.recovery: inspect the exact branch and worktree state and wait for the attributable worktree process without retrying mutation

failures.failed_witness: a read-only worktree-list recovery probe remained active after its wrapper while scanning 414 registered worktrees
failures.recovery: stop only the attributable orphaned list process and use literal branch and path probes

failures.failed_witness: the initial sparse checkout crossed its wrapper while its exact Git process still owned the transient index lock
failures.recovery: inspect exact process ownership and wait for that checkout to finish before any write

failures.failed_witness: a status probe was started before sparse checkout quiescence and remained blocked behind the active index operation
failures.recovery: stop only the attributable read-only status probe and avoid Git status until checkout quiescence

failures.failed_witness: an index-lock diagnostic used an inline PowerShell if expression in an object literal and failed parser evaluation
failures.recovery: bind the conditional scalar before constructing the diagnostic object

failures.failed_witness: a long Wait-Process wrapper outlived its output envelope after checkout remained active
failures.recovery: use bounded waits and verify the exact checkout process and index state separately

failures.failed_witness: the official CISA VEX page returned an HTTP 403 during read-only current-source verification
failures.recovery: retain the source-access failure and use the current official CycloneDX and OASIS CSAF primary specifications for vocabulary

failures.failed_witness: the first JavaScript wrapper for the large overview replacement parsed Markdown code ticks as source tokens and stopped before file mutation
failures.recovery: remove wrapper-sensitive code ticks from the bounded prose replacement and repeat the exact block rewrite

failures.failed_witness: the first x1 builder invocation crossed its output wrapper as the complete expected artifact set materialized
failures.recovery: verify process quiescence and the exact artifact set, then invoke the deterministic builder in a resumable terminal session

failures.failed_witness: the first installed authorization-state validation projection exceeded its bounded output budget after the read-only validator completed
failures.recovery: write the validator receipt to an external D-drive path and project only exit status, validity, error count, and digest

failures.failed_witness: the first bounded authorization recovery guessed a repository-local validator path that was absent from the sparse owner checkout
failures.recovery: resolve the exact installed ghc-family-auth-permission-state validator path before invocation

failures.failed_witness: that same bounded recovery attempted to parse the missing-file diagnostic as JSON and failed conversion
failures.recovery: require a successful validator exit and parse the explicitly written receipt rather than mixed process output

failures.failed_witness: the first diagnostic replay repeated the absent sparse-checkout validator path and returned the same missing-file failure
failures.recovery: stop using the sparse repository path and inspect the installed skill inventory directly

failures.failed_witness: a help probe also targeted the absent sparse-checkout validator path and failed before contract inspection
failures.recovery: run help against the exact installed skill validator and confirm its state and out arguments

failures.failed_witness: a source inspection probe targeted the same absent sparse-checkout path and returned a literal-path not-found error
failures.recovery: read the exact installed validator source and then run it with an external receipt path

recovery_rule: Every recovery is additive and never erases or relabels the failed witness.
